chipSemantics.outputRate: Public sample_rate returns configured host output rate. Native ticks are clock/8; YM2149 flags bit4 uses clock/16. Held tick values are integrated with integer durations into output frames.
chipSemantics.readback: Raw register bytes are retained/read at reg&15, including highbits and IO14/15. Effective tone coarse/noise/volume/envelope shapes mask4/5/5/4 bits; readback does not apply these masks. IO latches and direction bits have no external callbacks.
chipSemantics.envelope: AY16levels with two-tick steps; YM32levels with one-tick steps. All16 shapes; same-value shape writes retrigger step without resetting period counter. Toneperiod0 acts1; noise/envelope zero periods retain core behavior.
chipSemantics.noise: 17bit LFSR seeded1, feedbackbit0 xorbit3, noise prescaled2 and periodlow5bits.
chipSemantics.output: Three independent resistor/DAC channel tables (1000ohm loads), host averages three channels into identical stereo outputs; no nonlinear single-pin mix or DC removal. Flags bit0 chooses legacy normalization. Normalized flags1 volume0 has negative DC baseline, so zero variation is not zero PCM.
chipSemantics.resetMute: Raw reset zeros all16 register latches and synthesis/counters/integration, RNGseed1 and held samples; mute mask retained. Mute bits0..2 act after synthesis and before host average, so unmute resumes ongoingphase; only allmuted7 guarantees truezero independentDACbaseline.

reports.frameCountScope: Both builds: all main bodies+127-frame continuation probes including selected reset/replays. Bounded chip/Engine positives and actual Player render-ahead/seek-prefix generation are separate components. Engine delegates directly to the chip; those native output frames and Player delivered/discarded frames are not added twice.
limits: This standalone MAME adaptation generates at the configured output rate, not clock divided by a YMFM operator count. Integer integration of native ticks uses divider8, or16 for YM2149 flag0x10; no JavaScript resampler, held samples or clock-setting API is invented.

AY type0 supports flags0/1; YM2149 type0x10 supports0/1/0x10/0x11. Flag1 normalizes output tables; analog and normalized tables have DC baselines, including negative normalized level0. Dynamic range is required for changing test scenes; peak alone is not an audibility proof. Only mute7 is asserted exactzero.

Read returns the full stored register byte; internal tone-coarse/noise/volume/shape bits are interpreted masked. Raw C register arguments truncate to8 bits then mask register number to4 bits. Public writes validate0..15 and0..255. IO14/15 and direction bits are stored latches with no external CPU callbacks.

Raw and public reset both call the same in-place native reset: registers, RNG, tone/noise/envelope counters and integration history rewind. Native mute bits remain. Replay tests reapply neutral mute/gain controls before reset; retained mute is positively tested separately.

No state/snapshot, status/IRQ/hooks or Into API is exposed. Internal serialized state equality is not claimed; actual continuation PCM, readback, reset/replay and real Player replay-from-zero seek are compared.

Main raw cases render2048 frames at44100 with127-frame probes. Selected Engine cases render1536 frames at8000/44100/48000/96000 and test dispatch/gain/mutes directly. Player cases include all6profiles,3clocks and3rates with6seek positions.
No Browser, Worklet scheduling, Native backend, physical hardware, Mixer or listening judgement is tested.

resolvedFindings.issue: Initial partial-mask positive discarded reference PCM, so masks1/2/4 were only tested for phase preservation, not an observable mute effect.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Parity owner retained the already-rendered reference and added an explicit PCM difference assertion for each partial mask; final reports use this strengthened checker. No frames or counters were added.

coverageReview.DCAndProfiles: All six supported AY/YM2149 type/flag profiles have differing dynamic reference output. Shape and period positives use variation, avoiding DC-only false positives. Cold defaults are explicitly constant, and only all-mute7 is required to be exactzero.
coverageReview.readMasksAndIO: Public range rejection, C uint8 truncation/4-bit register aliases and original full-byte readback are separate from interpreted masks. All16 latches and IO direction/output latches are compared without inventing an external CPU port callback.
coverageReview.resetMuteAndOwnership: Public and raw reset both invoke in-place native reset, rewind counters/RNG/integration and retain presentation mute. Both owned PCM arrays survive overwrite and actual capacity growth; no recreate/free-running phase distinction, status/IRQ/hooks/Into or snapshot API is claimed.
coverageReview.engineAndVGM: Engine delegates one chip output frame per requested frame and applies gain once, with caller-subarray guards and phase-preserving mutes. VGM0xa0/header type+flags and real replay-from-zero seek cover6profiles×3clocks×3rates with6windows each and empty checkpoints.
coverageReview.frameAccounting: Recomputed body/probe/replay totals and independently counted bounded self-check calls match both reports. Engine delegated native frames and Player delivered/discarded frames are not double-counted.

playerFrameDerivation.method: Twice full7168-sample baseline; each seek prefix plus257 continuation consumes authored waits through next event boundary. Sum3rates×6profiles×3clocks×2builds. Player delivered/discardedframes are separate.

reviewedInvariants: All6supported profiles(type0flags0/1, YMtype16flags0/1/16/17) and3clocks are realWASM. sampleRate is configured outputrate, notclock/72;20extreme/legal clock-rate queries and unsupported constructor controls verify boundaries.

Raw register readback retains all8bits and register&15 aliases; effective coarse tone/noise/volume/shape masks are independently compared by actualPCM. IO14/15 and directionbits remain stored readable latches without CPU/audio callbacks.

All16envelope shapes and4periods,64tone/noise mixers,all32noise periods,16fixed levels and3tone channels are exercised. Eight canonical envelope trajectories differ; one-shot shape aliases coincide. Period0/1 behavior distinguishes AY two-tick envelopes fromYM one-tick envelopes.
Same-value shape write retriggers envelope steps; zero/min/max and dynamic periods preserve nativecounter semantics. Full reset rewinds registers,counters,RNG andintegration; mute selection remains.

Each partial mute1/2/4 now proves PCM changes relative to an already-rendered uninterrupted reference. Allmute7 alone proves exactzero, and unmute resumes exact tone/noise/envelope/integrationphase. Highbits are ignored.

DC-aware range/AC metrics prevent a constant baseline from passing an audible-variation check. Normalized flags1/17 coldvalue is-.125; flags0 analog DC is retained. No artificial zero-volume gate, filter or numeric gain change is introduced.
Owned arrays have changingPCM and both sides survive same-buffer overwrite and actual previouscapacity2048+1 growth. Disposed API calls reject; repeated disposal is safe.

Engine performs one chipframe per outputframe without aJS resampler. Initial1024 outputframes delegate in1call; both sides get mastergain once. Caller subarrays/tails, independentmask retention, mute continuation and gain/buffer guards are checked.
YM2149 doubled divider with flag10 and doubled inputclock restores bit-identical integer integrationPCM, positively separating modelclock controls.
No snapshot/state/status/IRQ/hooks/Into API exists or is invented. Actual registerreadback, continuationPCM and publicreset/replay are compared; no serialized-state equivalence claim.

Real VgmPlayer commandA0 andclock/type/flags headers74/78/79 are checked for6profiles×3clocks×3rates(54routes perbuild), each6seeks without checkpoints. Reset/replay-from-zero continuations match exactmonoPCM.

Main bodies/probes, bounded positives and actual PlayerEngine prefetch/seek-prefix generation are separate. Underlying directly delegated chipframes and Player delivered/discardedframes are not counted again.
